provenance.purpose: auditable early-design coordination for a declared sterile-product-like clean-production program
provenance.note: This combined project policy is not GMP, ISO 14644, HVAC, containment, healthcare, fire or construction-code approval.

rules.title: Declared clean-production flow categories are complete
rules.edition: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022 revision), sections 2.1 and 4.1-4.2
evidence: EU GMP Annex 1 identifies personnel, materials, equipment and surrounding environment as contamination sources to be addressed through facility, equipment and process design.
This project policy requires material, dirty-material, personnel, finished-goods and waste route declarations; it does not certify a contamination-control strategy.

rules.title: Declared raw-material-to-finished-goods sequence and waste branch are connected
rules.edition: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022 revision), sections 2.2, 2.3 and 4.2
evidence: EU GMP Annex 1 requires quality-risk-management consideration of facility, equipment and process design, including documented contamination-control interactions.
The ordered stages and waste branch are an explicit project process contract, not a universal GMP process sequence.

rules.title: Declared clean and dirty route categories use separate intermediate rooms
rules.edition: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022 revision), sections 4.2, 4.11 and 4.12
evidence: EU GMP Annex 1 calls for technical and operational separation to prevent mix-up and contamination and describes separate or controlled movement of materials, personnel and waste.
This deterministic check reports shared intermediate rooms as a coordination conflict. It does not evaluate time-based procedures, transfer disinfection, airflow visualisation or a CCS.

rules.title: Applicable cleanroom and airlock zones carry class and pressure evidence
evidence: ISO 14644-1:2015 specifies classification of air cleanliness in cleanrooms and clean zones by particle concentration.
EU GMP Annex 1 section 4.14 makes pressure/airflow part of the facility strategy. This project check requires declared data only and does not calculate classification, ventilation or airflow.

rules.title: Cleanroom labels use the project ISO vocabulary and declared parent ordering
evidence: ISO 14644-1:2015 covers classification of air cleanliness in cleanrooms and clean zones by airborne particle concentration.
The vocabulary and hierarchy are a project data contract. This check does not calculate particle concentrations or certify a room classification.

rules.title: Separate personnel and material airlock roles have declared parent cleanroom zones
rules.edition: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022 revision), sections 4.1 and 4.12
evidence: EU GMP Annex 1 describes entry through change rooms acting as airlocks and states that personnel and material airlocks should be separated wherever possible.
This check requires roles and parent-zone evidence. It does not verify door interlocking, transfer procedures or final airlock-stage conditions.

rules.title: Declared cleanroom-to-airlock pressure ordering meets the sourced project guidance
evidence: EU GMP Annex 1 section 4.14 calls for positive pressure and/or airflow relative to a lower-grade background and gives 10 Pascals as a guidance value for adjacent rooms of different grades.
Containment scenarios can require another justified strategy. This project check compares declared zone values only; it does not model HVAC, adjacency interfaces or airflow visualisation.

This deterministic check reports shared intermediate rooms as a coordination conflict. It does not evaluate time-based procedures, transfer disinfection, airflow visualisation or a CCS.
